Post 1
🔻 ASX 200 slipped 14.20 points or 0.16% to 9,005.90 Friday. Fuel retailers cratered while gold miners surged — a market split clean down the middle. Down 0.95% on the week. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
Energy worst sector at -1.22%, dragged by Ampol and Viva. IT led gains at +1.00%, Telcos close behind at +0.98%. Defensive rotation quietly building underneath a flat headline. #ASX #energy #ausbiz

Post 3
🔻 Ampol fell AUD 2.60 or 6.01% to AUD 40.65. Viva Energy dropped 3.65% same session. Fuel refiner pain concentrated and sharp — not sector noise, a structural question. #ASX #energy #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,264.77/oz. Silver AUD 93.39/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.7206, metals priced in local terms stay elevated — a cushion for ASX gold names outperforming today. #ASX #gold #mining

Post 5
ASX sits 3.13% below its 52-week high. Can 9,000 hold as support? Watch gold above AUD 6,264/oz and energy sector direction Monday. Where do you see the index heading next week? #ASX #ausbiz
